div.div:
PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD, under 10 MB and 200 pages, at
most 20 per writer (FR-84). A document is the
writer's alone: it never feeds writer memory,
Portfolio Insights or search, and no other account
can read, attach or discover it (FR-87).
